statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PAYING TRIBUTE TO A DEDICATED CONGRESSIONAL STAFF MEMBER, MS. DEBORAH PERRY
statements.title: PAYING TRIBUTE TO A DEDICATED CONGRESSIONAL STAFF MEMBER, MS. DEBORAH PERRY
sentences: She began her career as a civil servant, spending nearly a decade working for Baltimore City's Police Department and Department of Social Services.

After briefly working in the Congressional offices of Frederick Richmond (D-NY-14) and Julian Dixon (D-CA-28), Ms. Perry started a business, Case Management Plus, providing outsourcing services to attorneys to assist with personal injury and workers' compensation cases.
In a testament to her character, after the 2008 financial crash, Ms. Perry came out of retirement to help handle the influx of housing and foreclosure cases.
She worked tirelessly for struggling Baltimoreans, developing and organizing 12 Foreclosure Prevention Workshops.
